featured.name: Tab Zero
featured.alt: Conceptual illustration of egocentric video and web tasks sharing a browser interface.
featured.summary: A unified browser interface that lets web agents inspect egocentric video and complete web tasks using shared browser actions.
featured.result: Up to 8.0 percentage points higher zero-shot task success rate than uniform sampling on the filtered Ego2Web subset.

featured.name: StreamClarify
featured.alt: Conceptual illustration of a video stream, hierarchical memory, and clarification for video question answering.
featured.summary: A training-free framework for frozen vision-language models, combining entropy-based clarification, temporal-pyramid KV caching, and semantic retrieval.
featured.result: Built StreamClarify-QA: 1,837 QA pairs from 355 videos. Evaluated three VLM backbones, with macro accuracy gains of up to 8.2 percentage points over existing streaming video QA methods.

featured.name: TransMIL
featured.alt: Conceptual illustration of whole-slide image patches aggregated by a Transformer for slide classification.
featured.summary: Transformer-based multiple instance learning that models correlations among image patches for whole-slide image classification.
featured.result: Earlier work on learning from weak supervision, incorporating spatial context into visual representations.
